label: GST registration turnover threshold (non-profit)
quote: totals $75,000 or more ($150,000 or more for non-profit organisations)
notes: The page states no start date. $150,000 was first specified in regulation 23-15.02 of the 1999 regulations by the A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Amendment Regulations 2007 (No. 2) (SLI 2007 No. 206), which commenced on 1 July 2007: https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/pdf/reg/r20070206.pdf. The A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Regulations 2019 keep the amount in s 23-15.02: https://www.legislation.gov.au/F2019L00417/latest
